schema: 1
package: webspec-semantics

rules:
  - id: event-fire-generic
    description: The DOM fire-an-event primitive is an intrinsic event effect. The name is unknown until a caller provides a supported literal.
    match:
      anchor: DOM#concept-event-fire
    emit:
      kind: event.fire
      params:
        name: null
  - id: event-fire-literal-name
    description: Recover a literal event name when the complete fire operation is present at the linked reference.
    match:
      anchor: DOM#concept-event-fire
      text: '(?i)\b(?:fire|firing) an event named (?P<name>`[^`]+`|\*[^*]+\*)'
    emit:
      kind: event.fire
      params:
        name:
          capture: name
          from: literal
    expect:
      - direct-two-sites
      - variable-name
      - named-event-note
      - multiple-event-operations
      - mention-only
      - navigation-history-events
      - inflected-event-names
  - id: event-fire-code-name
    description: Recover the event name from the unquoted code-token spelling used by HTML for fixed event names such as popstate and hashchange. The capture excludes variable tokens and quoted code.
    match:
      anchor: DOM#concept-event-fire
      text: '(?i)\b(?:fire|firing) an event named `(?P<name>[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*)`'
    emit:
      kind: event.fire
      params:
        name:
          capture: name
          from: text
    expect:
      - navigation-history-events
      - inflected-event-names
      - queued-event-boundary
  - id: event-dispatch-generic
    description: Dispatch is a separate DOM operation from firing; generic dispatch keeps its name unknown.
    match:
      anchor: DOM#concept-event-dispatch
    emit:
      kind: event.dispatch
      params:
        name: null
    expect:
      - navigation-dispatch
      - dispatch-initialization-negative
  - id: navigation-dispatch-name
    description: "Reviewed Navigation API case: initialization of the NavigateEvent type does not itself dispatch; the later dispatch operation is scoped to this algorithm and reports the known navigate name."
    match:
      anchor: DOM#concept-event-dispatch
      subject: HTML#inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm
      text: '(?i)dispatching\s+\*event\*\s+at\s+\*navigation\*'
    emit:
      kind: event.dispatch
      params:
        name: navigate
    expect:
      - navigation-dispatch
      - dispatch-initialization-negative

schema: 1
package: webspec-semantics
rules:
  - id: add-to-field-collection
    description: Unlinked "Add X to R's F" adds to a set- or list-valued field.
    match:
      text: '(?:^|, then |; )Add (?P<operand>.+?) to (?P<target>(?:the |this )?\S.*?)(?:\.|,|;|$)'
      exclude_text:
        - '(?i)\badd \S+ to \*\w+\*(?:\.|$)'   # local accumulators
        - '(?:^|, then |; )Add to \*\w+\* '    # "Add to *list* X": local list, operand after it
    emit:
      kind: state.mutate
      params:
        op: append
        target: {capture: target, from: path}
        operand: {capture: operand, from: text}
  - id: decrease-by
    match:
      text: '(?:^|, |and )decrease (?P<target>.+?) by '
    emit:
      kind: state.mutate
      params: {op: decrement, target: {capture: target, from: path}}
  - id: html-canvas-reset-transform
    description: >-
      "The resetTransform() method, when invoked, must reset the current transformation
      matrix to the identity matrix." "Reset" is not a grammar verb, so the IR leaves the
      occurrence unclassified.
    match:
      subject: HTML#dom-context-2d-resettransform
      text: 'must reset the current transformation matrix to '
    emit:
      kind: state.write
      params: {field: HTML#current-transformation-matrix, op: set}
  - id: remove-from-field-collection
    description: Unlinked "Remove X from R's F" removes from a set- or list-valued field.
    match:
      text: '(?:^|, then |; )Remove (?P<operand>.+?) from (?P<target>(?:the |this )?\S.*?)(?:\.|,|;|$)'
      exclude_text: ['(?i)\bremove \S+ from \*\w+\*(?:\.|$)']   # local lists
    emit:
      kind: state.mutate
      params:
        op: remove
        target: {capture: target, from: path}
        operand: {capture: operand, from: text}
  - id: insert-into-field-collection
    description: Unlinked "Insert X into R's F" inserts into a list-valued field.
    match:
      text: '(?:^|, then |; )Insert (?P<operand>.+?) into (?P<target>(?:the |this )?\S.*?)(?:\.|,|;|$)'
      exclude_text: ['(?i)\binsert \S+ into \*\w+\*(?:\.|$)']   # local lists
    emit:
      kind: state.mutate
      params:
        op: insert
        target: {capture: target, from: path}
        operand: {capture: operand, from: text}
  - id: change-field-to
    description: >-
      "Change R's F to V" replaces the field's value. state.mutate has no set op, so the
      rule uses replace, the mutation op for a whole-value change.
    match:
      text: '(?:^|, then |; )Change (?P<target>(?:the |this )?\S.*?) to (?P<operand>.+?)(?:\.|;|$)'
      exclude_text: ['(?i)\bchange \*\w+\* to ']   # local variables
    emit:
      kind: state.mutate
      params:
        op: replace
        target: {capture: target, from: path}
        operand: {capture: operand, from: text}
